2609.13731.title: Trustworthy Agentic AI: A Comprehensive Cybersecurity and Systems Survey on Threat Landscapes, Defense Architectures, and Open Challenges
2609.13731.paper_summary: The transition from passive foundation models to autonomous, goal-directed agentic AI systems has introduced unprecedented capabilities by coupling recursive cognitive reasoning loops, persistent memory architectures, live tool execution planes, and multi-agent collaboration topologies. However, granting probabilistic neural cores execution authority across filesystems, networks, and cloud infrastructure dissolves classical security perimeters: natural language simultaneously serves as input data, internal control code, and communication protocols, exposing a Turing-complete blast radius where untrusted data represents executable instructions. This survey delivers a comprehensive systems-security reference framework for trustworthy agentic AI, synthesizing 206 foundational studies and regulatory standards. We formalize the general agent architecture as a stateful 5-tuple and establish a 6-dimensional trustworthiness taxonomy covering security, safety, privacy, explainability, fairness, and accountability. We systematically analyze threat surfaces across intra-execution loops and interaction planes, formulate a multi-layered zero-trust defense-in-depth architecture integrating Dual-LLM isolation, Capability-Based Access Control, kernel eBPF probes, and sandboxed runtimes, review standardized evaluation benchmarks, and map technical controls to international AI governance frameworks.
2609.13731.paper_summary_zh: 從被動基礎模型過渡到自主的、目標導向的智能代理 AI 系統，引入了前所未有的能力，這是通過結合遞歸認知推理循環、持久記憶架構、實時工具執行平面和多代理協作拓撲實現的。<lb/>然而，授予概率神經核心在檔案系統、網絡和雲基礎設施上執行權限，會解構傳統的安全邊界：自然語言同時作為輸入數據、內部控制代碼和通信協議，暴露出一個圖靈完備的爆炸半徑，其中不受信任的數據代表可執行指令。<lb/>本調查提供了一個全面的系統安全參考框架，旨在建立可信的智能代理 AI，綜合了 206 項基礎研究和監管標準。<lb/>我們將一般代理架構形式化為一個有狀態的 5 元組，並建立了一個涵蓋安全性、安全性、隱私、可解釋性、公平性和問責制的 6 維可信度分類法。<lb/>我們系統地分析了內部執行循環和交互平面的威脅表面，制定了一個多層次的零信任深度防禦架構，整合了雙 LLM 隔離、基於能力的訪問控制、內核 eBPF 探針和沙盒運行時，審查標準化評估基準，並將技術控制映射到國際 AI 治理框架。
2609.13731.author: Seyedakbar Mostafavi et.al.
